اجرنثموا (form IIIq)
# اِجْرَنْثَمُوا (ijranṯamū) /id͡ʒ.ran.θa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِجْرَنْثَمَ (ijranṯama)
# اِجْرَنْثِمُوا (ijranṯimū) /id͡ʒ.ran.θi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِجْرَنْثَمَ (ijranṯama)
